You are fixing one small item in the Callisto repo (Rust workspace, your cwd is an isolated git worktree off origin/main; Callisto is 0.21.x). Read AGENTS.md and ARCHITECTURE.md briefly first. Be lean: smallest complete change, no new error codes or config keys, comments one short line only when the WHY is non-obvious, no history words in comments.

TASK: `crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs:5-29` hand-writes an 18-triple table (`triple_host_runner_use_cross`), parallel to `napi::triple_to_role` (crates/callisto-graph/src/napi.rs). Its own doc comment calls itself 'NEW code' separate from napi. Make one source of truth for target triples so they cannot drift: derive/share the data (e.g. one table in callisto-model or callisto-graph that both use), keeping behaviour byte-identical (matrix JSON output, napi roles). First read both and decide the smallest shared shape; if they cannot share without a behaviour change or a new public API, STOP and report why instead of forcing it. Add or keep a test that fails if the two ever disagree (prefer a compiler-enforced shape over a text-scan test). If it changes user-visible behaviour, add a `.changeset/<slug>.md` (frontmatter `callisto-cli: patch`, 3 short bullets Before/Now/You do not need to do anything); if it is a pure refactor, no changeset.

CHECKS (judge by exit code only, never by grepping output; one cargo invocation at a time): `cargo test -p callisto-graph`, `cargo test -p callisto-cli --test cli_tests`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `sh testing/check-comments.sh`. The callisto-graph suite has shown rare intermittent exit 101 that does not reproduce: rerun once before treating it as yours, and report it if it recurs.

SHIP (plain separate git commands, no compound or looped git, no `git -C`; Bash with dangerouslyDisableSandbox true for git commit/push/entire/gh): branch `refactor/one-target-triple-table`; commit signed (`git commit -S`; never override signing; conventional message, no session links, no AI attribution lines); `git push -u origin <branch>`; then `entire trail link 430 --project gh/orin-dx --repo gh/orin-dx/callisto --branch <branch> --base main`; then `entire trail ci-pr 430 --project gh/orin-dx --repo gh/orin-dx/callisto --branch <branch> --json` (never use `gh pr create`, it needs Touch ID). Do NOT approve or merge. Do not touch files outside this task.

Report in under 120 words: what you changed, check exit codes you ran, PR number, and anything you chose not to do.
